part5.q: If the shipment ____ tomorrow, we will need to inform the client immediately.
part5.explain: 가정법에서 if절은 현재 시제로 미래를 나타냅니다. 따라서 'arrives'가 정답입니다. 'will arrive'는 if절에 쓸 수 없습니다.

part5.q: If I ____ you, I would accept the job offer without hesitation.
part5.explain: 가정법 과거에서 be동사는 주어에 관계없이 'were'를 사용합니다. 따라서 'were'가 정답입니다.

part5.q: Had she ____ the instructions carefully, she would not have made such a mistake.
part5.explain: 가정법 과거완료에서 if가 생략되면 조동사 had가 주어 앞으로 나오고, 동사는 과거분사가 옵니다. 따라서 'read'가 정답입니다.

part5.q: I wish I ____ more time to prepare for the presentation yesterday.
part5.explain: I wish 뒤에 과거 사실에 대한 아쉬움을 나타낼 때는 가정법 과거를 씁니다. 따라서 'had'가 정답입니다.

part5.q: Without your help, we ____ the project on time.
part5.explain: Without은 'If it had not been for'와 같은 의미로 가정법 과거완료를 이끕니다. 따라서 'would not have finished'가 정답입니다.

passage.title: Email: Conference Schedule Update
passage.body:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@techsolutions.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@techsolutions.com>
Date: March 15, 2025
Subject: Conference Schedule Update

Dear Daniel,

I am writing to inform you of a change to the schedule for the upcoming Global Business Conference. Due to a last-minute conflict, the keynote speaker, Dr. Emily Carter, has requested to move her presentation from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. on the first day.

As a result, we need to adjust the morning sessions. The panel discussion originally scheduled for 11:00 a.m. will now take place at 9:00 a.m. in Hall B. Please note that the room assignment for the panel remains the same.

Could you please update the conference program and notify the attendees as soon as possible? Also, let me know if you need any assistance with the revisions.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
Laura Chen
Conference Coordinator

questions.q: What is the purpose of the email?
choices: To request a change in the conference schedule
To inform about a schedule change
questions.explain: 이메일의 목적은 일정 변경에 대해 알리는 것입니다. 첫 문단에서 'I am writing to inform you of a change to the schedule'라고 명시되어 있습니다.
questions.evidence: I am writing to inform you of a change to the schedule for the upcoming Global Business Conference.

questions.q: What time will the panel discussion take place?
questions.explain: 패널 토론은 원래 11시였으나 9시로 변경되었습니다. 지문에서 'The panel discussion originally scheduled for 11:00 a.m. will now take place at 9:00 a.m.'라고 언급되어 있습니다.
questions.evidence: The panel discussion originally scheduled for 11:00 a.m. will now take place at 9:00 a.m. in Hall B.

questions.q: What is Daniel asked to do?
choices: Reserve a new room for the panel
Update the program and notify attendees
questions.explain: Laura는 Daniel에게 프로그램을 업데이트하고 참석자들에게 알려달라고 요청합니다. 지문에서 'Could you please update the conference program and notify the attendees'라고 되어 있습니다.
questions.evidence: Could you please update the conference program and notify the attendees as soon as possible?

questions.q: What is indicated about the room for the panel discussion?
choices: It has been changed to Hall A.
questions.explain: 패널 토론의 장소는 변경되지 않았습니다. 지문에서 'the room assignment for the panel remains the same'라고 언급되어 있습니다.
questions.evidence: Please note that the room assignment for the panel remains the same.

confusable.diff: lend = 빌려주다(lend A to B) / borrow = 빌리다(borrow A from B)

vocab.tip: 접속사 vs 전치사: 빈칸 뒤에 '주어+동사'가 오면 접속사(Since), 명사만 오면 전치사(Because of)입니다.
